{
  "name": "codex-pet",
  "version": "0.5.0",
  "description": "Your Codex pet, living above the Claude Code prompt: it works while Claude works, waits when you are needed, and celebrates when a turn is done.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Steven Pan"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "pet",
    "codex",
    "companion",
    "status"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "pet": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pet",
      "description": "Which pet to show: auto (an installed Codex pet, else the Codex app's own, else the bundled Blob), or a pet's id as /pet list names it. /pet use <id> overrides this.",
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "size": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Size",
      "description": "How large the pet is drawn. Desktop: 72, 104 or 156 pixels tall. A terminal picture: 4, 6 or 9 rows. Terminal blocks: 7 rows for small, 13 otherwise.",
      "options": [
        "small",
        "medium",
        "large"
      ],
      "default": "medium"
    },
    "animation": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Animation",
      "description": "lively: always moving. calm: a pet that is idle, waiting or up for review rests between movements. still: one frame a mood.",
      "options": [
        "lively",
        "calm",
        "still"
      ],
      "default": "calm"
    },
    "label": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Label",
      "description": "Show the pet's name and what it is doing beside it.",
      "default": true
    },
    "align": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Position",
      "description": "Where the pet stands in the band above the prompt.",
      "options": [
        "left",
        "center",
        "right"
      ],
      "default": "center"
    },
    "terminalCells": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Terminal cell shape",
      "description": "For the picture and blocks in a terminal. standard: its character cells are about twice as tall as they are wide. tall: they are taller than that (roomy line spacing), which makes the pet look stretched upward; this draws it wider to compensate.",
      "options": [
        "standard",
        "tall"
      ],
      "default": "standard"
    },
    "terminalStyle": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "In a terminal",
      "description": "auto: the pet's own picture where the terminal shows images (kitty, Ghostty), and a small face of characters elsewhere. picture: always try the picture. face: always the face. blocks: the pet drawn in coarse blocks of color.",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "picture",
        "face",
        "blocks"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    }
  },
  "repository": "https://github.com/steven-panxd/codex-pet-in-claude",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/steven-panxd/codex-pet-in-claude"
}
